title: Design-Glanza Design Tokens
description: The machine-readable shape of one product's design-tokens.json, per design-tokens/token-schema.md. Every scale's actual values are owned by ui-engine/design-system.md, typography.md, layout-system.md, color-system.md, and responsive-system.md — this schema only fixes the structure. Not currently invoked by any script directly; scripts/validate-tokens.py implements the equivalent checks (see design-tokens/token-audit.md).

masterSkillVersion.description: The design-glanza master skill version this token set was generated against, per config/master-config.md's Version field — same tracking mechanism as product.json's master_skill_version.

token.description: Generic shape reference — every leaf token in every category below follows this shape.

value.description: A bare value, or a {light, dark} pair when themeable is true.

secondary.description: Optional 9-10 step ramp, same technique as primary.

semantic.description: Each key (except text) is a {foreground, background, border} triplet per color-system.md. 'text' is {primary, muted}. See design-tokens/semantic-tokens.md for the full name reconciliation (error == color-system.md's 'danger').

lineHeight.description: Per role, matching the size scale.

letterSpacing.description: ui-engine/typography.md's letter-spacing (tracking) scale: tight/normal/wide. Optional — theme-invariant, Latin-script default (see typography.md's Non-Latin script section for the exception).

elevation.description: ui-engine/design-system.md's elevation scale, levels 0-4. themeable: true is expected here (dark-mode lighter-fill expression).

zIndex.description: ui-engine/design-system.md's z-index scale, mirroring elevation's 0-4 levels as 0/100/200/300/400.

product.description: Domain/product-specific additions with no home in the 14 master categories, per design-tokens/token-inheritance.md. Never a replacement for a master category — additions only.
